name: painintheagent-mcp
description: Remove text watermarks, humanize and check AI writing with your Pain in the Agent account.

tools.name: start_rewrite
tools.description: Remove a text watermark; uses characters from the monthly plan.

tools.name: get_rewrite
tools.description: Read progress or the saved rewrite.

tools.name: start_humanize
tools.description: Humanize AI text and remove its watermark; uses characters from the monthly plan.

tools.name: start_watermark_comparison
tools.description: Compare two versions for meaning changes; free within the daily check limit.

tools.name: start_ai_detection
tools.description: Score text with an AI detector and highlight patterns; free within the daily check limit.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Read progress or a saved result for any text tool.

api_key.title: Pain in the Agent API key
api_key.description: Create a key while signed in at https://painintheagent.com/integrations/. Rewrites need the $5 monthly plan on that account.

base_url.title: Service base URL
base_url.description: Keep the default unless your operator provides an API gateway.
